name: Classic Pac-Man Arcade
description: Authentic Retro Arcade, Handheld & Console Hub featuring the 1994 Sony PlayStation 1 (PS1 32-bit CD-ROM console with double-speed drive, DualShock controllers, Memory Cards, Crash Bandicoot 3D, and Ridge Racer 3D), the 2003 Nintendo Game Boy Advance SP (foldable clamshell 32-bit console with AGS-101/001 screen modes, 6 metallic shell colorways, and cartridges for Pokémon Emerald, Super Mario Advance 4, and The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap), 1989 Nintendo Game Boy (DMG-01 Handheld Console with Dot Matrix LCD, 4-shade green palettes, physical cartridge switcher, Super Mario Land & Tetris Game Boy Edition), 1984 Impossible Mission (Dennis Caswell / Epyx / Commodore 64 6510 & SID 6581 with ESS digitized speech, gymnastic somersault physics, and 36 punch-card puzzle pieces), 1988 Exile (Peter Irvin & Jeremy Smith / Superior Software / BBC Micro Mode 5 6502 Newtonian Physics Sandbox on Planet Phoebus), 1986 Sega OutRun (Yu Suzuki / Super Scaler Pseudo-3D Road Engine with hills & curves / Red Ferrari Testarossa Spider / In-Car FM Radio with Magical Sound Shower, Passing Breeze & Splash Wave), 1983 Q*bert (Superior Software / Gottlieb / Isometric 3D Pyramid with Coily & Flying Disks), 1982 Rocket Raid (Acornsoft / Jonathan Griffiths / BBC Micro & Electron Scramble with 5 sections & Acorn Grijs monochrome), 1982 Zaxxon (Sega / Ikegami Tsushinki / First Isometric 3D Shooter with Floor Shadow Physics), 1998 Half-Life (Valve / Gabe Newell & Marc Laidlaw / GoldSrc High-Res 1920x1280 3D FPS), 1996 Duke Nukem 3D (3D Realms / Build Engine / High-Res WebGL), 1993 DOOM (id Software / John Carmack & John Romero / 3D FPS), 1987 Double Dragon (Technos Japan / 2.5D Beat 'em Up), 1997 Nokia Snake (Taneli Armanto / Nokia 6110 84x48 LCD), 1989-1990 Prince of Persia (Jordan Mechner / Brøderbund / MS-DOS Rotoscoped Platformer), 1979 Asteroids (Atari Vector DVG / Lyle Rains & Ed Logg), 1981 3D Monster Maze (Sinclair ZX81 16K / Malcolm Evans 3D Survival Horror), 1983 Manic Miner (Matthew Smith / Sinclair ZX Spectrum), 1991 Lemmings (DMA Design / Psygnosis / C64 8-bit Destructible Physics), 2011 Temple Run 3D (Imangi Studios / Three.js 3D Runner), 1989 3D Pinball Power (Commodore 64 / Mastertronic), 1985 Super Mario Bros. (Nintendo NES / Shigeru Miyamoto), 1992 Wolfenstein 3D (id Software / Three.js 3D), 1983 Mario Bros. (Nintendo Arcade), 1988 Battle Chess (Interplay), 1972 Atari Pong, 1984 King's Quest I (Sierra / IBM PC), 1986 Space Quest, 1984 Tetris, 1982 BBC Micro Arcadians, 1984 BBC Micro FRAK!, 1983 Chuckie Egg, 1982 Frogger, 1985 Eindeloos, 1985 Repton, 1982 Demon Attack, 1978 Space Invaders, and 1980 Pac-Man.
